## 中文原文
周末你带宝宝去小区游乐场。一开始宝宝看着别的小朋友滑滑梯有点害羞，紧紧抓着你的手指。过了一会儿，他慢慢放松下来，还试着自己爬上低矮的小台阶，开心地笑了。

## My translation
This weekend, I took my baby to the community's playground.
At the begining, my baby was a bit shy watching other children playing the slide, and held my fingers tightly.
After a while, he gradually relaxed and tried to climb on a low step, and laughed happily.

## Revised version
This weekend, I took my baby to the playground in our community.
At first, he was a little shy. He watched the other kids going down the slide and held onto my fingers tightly.
After a while, he warmed up. He tried climbing up the low step and laughed happily.

## Key phrases
- going down the slide，滑滑梯
- held onto my fingers，紧抓着手
- warmed up
- climb up
